appDescription.message: Look in video calls the way you see yourself in the mirror. For Google Meet and Zoom in the browser.

outgoingHint.message: Mirrored is how you see yourself in a mirror.

statusOtherSite.message: Open Google Meet or Zoom in the browser.

statusActive.message: On for $SITE$. Changes apply instantly, even during a call.

statusReload.message: Reload this $SITE$ tab to turn it on.

welcomeLead.message: In video calls, people can now see you the way you see yourself in a mirror.

welcomeStep1.message: Click the puzzle icon in Chrome's toolbar and pin Mirrorly.

welcomeStep2.message: Choose what others see, and what you see of yourself.

welcomeStep3.message: If Google Meet or Zoom is already open, reload that tab.

welcomeZoom.message: Works in Google Meet and the Zoom web client. The Zoom desktop app is coming soon.

welcomePrivacy.message: Everything happens on your computer. Mirrorly sends no video and no data anywhere.
